episodes.title: 1,000 People Fight For $5,000,000
episodes.summary: I gathered 1,000 people to fight for $5,000,000, the LARGEST cash prize in TV history! I don't know why you're still reading this, go watch it right now! No more spoilers.

episodes.title: 500 People Trapped In My City
episodes.summary: The remaining 500 contestants must fight to stay in the MASSIVE city I built from scratch (not joking). The end of the episode may be the craziest thing that's ever happened in television history. Watch it right now!

episodes.title: The Solitary Experiment
episodes.summary: What would happen if three best friends were trapped in a room, but only two could escape? Watch and see for yourself right now!

episodes.title: The Golden Ticket
episodes.summary: The rules are simple: fight for a seat on the helicopters, or lose $5,000,000. My private island awaits.

episodes.title: Fight to Win a Private Island
episodes.summary: You're about to witness someone win a private island AND continue to compete for $5,000,000. I just sent the Navy SEALs to hunt these players down. Stop reading and watch this episode.

episodes.title: Physical, Mental, Chance...Your Choice
episodes.summary: I gave the remaining contestants a choice. Play a physical game, play a mental game, or play a game completely left up to chance. No excuses!

episodes.title: The Elimination Train
episodes.summary: How much money would it take to eliminate your best friend? Watch this episode as players make the hardest decisions of their lives. This one is brutal.

episodes.title: Betray Your Friend For $1,000,000
episodes.summary: The remaining 10 players take their share of $1,000,000 AGAIN. Will they split it evenly or will one of them take it all?

episodes.title: Bribe Your Way To The Finale
episodes.summary: The final 10 use all of their current winnings to bribe their way to the finals. Lying and deception are at an all-time high, making it difficult to trust even your closest allies.

episodes.title: $10,000,000 Coin Flip
episodes.summary: One contestant flips a coin to potentially double the grand prize to $10,000,000 or get eliminated. Beast Games crowns the winner of season 1.

episodes.title: Strong vs Smart Compete for $5,000,000
episodes.summary: 200 of the strongest competitors and smartest minds in the world battle for 100 spots in Beast City to keep fighting for their chance at the $5,000,000 prize. Only the best of each team will advance as the Strong compete in a game of perseverance while the Smart battle in a game of focus - who will move on and who will go home?

episodes.title: Choose Your Fate
episodes.summary: After an unexpected twist, the 50 Smartest and 50 Strongest face their biggest decision yet. A $1,000,000 bribe is on the line that could change the course of the entire season: will the contestants accept MrBeast's life-changing offer? Or will they risk it all and bet everything on a challenge of their choice? The stakes couldn't be higher as players fight to earn their place among the Top 50.

episodes.title: The Obstacle Course
episodes.summary: The Top 50 face their next brutal challenge, an obstacle course that demands the perfect balance of strength and smarts. As new alliances form and old friendships crumble, every victory counts with only half the contestants advancing. A fan-favorite challenge returns, testing loyalty and shattering promises. Everyone has a price, but who will break first?

episodes.title: The Survivor Takeover
episodes.summary: Survivor and Beast Games collide in the biggest competition crossover of all-time! Legendary host Jeff Probst joins MrBeast as contestants arrive on the world-famous Survivor island. Players face a series of iconic Survivor-inspired challenges with a $1,800,000 private island on the line. It all comes down to a Final Tribal Council… who will be Beast Games' newest millionaire?

episodes.title: Ask For Anything You Want
episodes.summary: The $10,000,000 Coin returns! As the Islanders come home, shifting power dynamics throw Beast City into chaos. The top 20 face their biggest challenge yet as the infamous Cubes reappear alongside surprise guest Druski. Three enter, but only two can leave as players can ask for anything to help make this impossible choice. Can you still trust your allies when a life-changing prize is on the line?

episodes.title: Hearts Will Be Smashed
episodes.summary: A battle between brains and biceps takes place 100 feet in the air and across a massive life-sized puzzle to crown the strongest and smartest player in Beast City. Lies and deceit run wild as the winners must decide on three players' hearts to smash, eliminating them from the game entirely! No one is safe in Beast City… but first, will the $10,000,000 Coin even survive the final Cube?

episodes.title: Bury Me Alive
episodes.summary: The final heart is smashed and for the Top 10, the pressure of the $5,000,000 prize has never been higher. After weeks of competition, an unexpected surprise changes everything… the contestants are reunited with their families and reminded exactly what they're fighting for. But things take a twist when the players visit the "graveyard" of the eliminated and discover they'll be buried alive!

episodes.title: Would You Steal $1,000,000?
episodes.summary: Buried underground with $1,000,000 up for grabs, every choice counts as each contestant can secretly take as much money as their heart desires. Personal stakes and old grudges collide as the tension between the players reaches a boiling point. Will they take their fair share, or will a new villain emerge once again?

episodes.title: Trust Nobody
episodes.summary: Voting begins... with nothing but a phone and their share of $1,000,000, the remaining players battle in a game of wits and social strategy to determine the Final 6. Friendships are tested and bribes run wild as one player's big secret is threatened to be exposed. How much is a spot in the finale worth, and who's willing to pay the price?

episodes.title: $5,000,000 Decision
episodes.summary: Former alliances are shattered as the final six contestants backstab and scheme their way to bring $5,000,000 home. A truly life-changing amount of money is at their fingertips, but will it be Team Strong or Team Smart that is ultimately crowned the next Beast Games champion?!
